layout.arrangement: Figure-only slide. Maroon outer frame; crimson-bordered white plot panel center-left with light-gray grid, dark axis cross at (0,0), blue upper-left cloud and red lower crescent; yellow badge '50' top-right outside panel; solid black letterbox bar along bottom.

regions.name: plot_panel
regions.content: White panel, crimson stroke #D02452, grid + scatter

visual_elements.description: Grid #E3E3E3 verticals at data x=-10..50, horizontals y=-10..40; origin (0,0) at pixel ~(306,358); x scale ~7.44 px/unit, y ~7.0 px/unit; tick ink #333333
Dark axis segments #2F2F2F: vertical x=0 from y=0 to y=30 [0.316,0.276,0.322,0.667]; horizontal y=0 from x=0 to x=50 [0.319,0.659,0.706,0.667]
Blue series #0000E6 filled circle markers, bbox [0.34,0.32,0.58,0.55], ~70 pts, data x~0-28, y~14-28
Red series #FF0000 filled circle markers as lower crescent, bbox [0.46,0.46,0.71,0.73], ~150 pts, data x~14-42, y~3-18 (dips to y~3 near x~28-32, rises to y~17 near x~41)
Small dark cursor/mouse pointer near pixel (552,285) [0.573,0.520,0.583,0.540], #1A1A1A [?]

typography_notes: Sans-serif (Helvetica/Arial-like). Tick labels ~7-8 pt regular #333333; y right-aligned, x centered; digits with minus sign. Badge '50' ~13 pt weight 600 black centered. No title/bullets/body.
